Internet-Draft                                         Agent Transport
Expires: 2027                                             November 2026

Abstract

   This draft defines the example transport.

Table of Contents

   1.  Introduction  ........................................  2
   2.  Requirements  ........................................  3

1.  Introduction

   The transport carries agent messages.  It is not a replacement
   for HTTP.

2.  Requirements

2.1.  Framing

   A sender MUST NOT send a frame larger than 64 KiB.  A receiver
   SHOULD close the stream on a violation.

2.2.  Security Considerations

   Implementations MAY log frame headers.

Appendix A.  Examples

   None yet.
